verse.verse_1: I CALL TO witness the sky (bespangled) with the signs of the Zodiac,
verse.verse_3: And the witness and the witnessed,
verse.verse_4: That accursed are the men of the trench
verse.verse_5: Full of fire fed by faggots,
verse.verse_7: Witnessing what they had done to the believers!
verse.verse_8: They had no other reason for hating them except that they believed in God the mighty, worthy of praise,
verse.verse_9: Whose kingdom spreads over the heavens and the earth. God is witness over everything.
verse.verse_10: Surely for those who persecute believers, men and women, and do not repent afterwards, is the punishment of Hell, and the punishment of burning.
verse.verse_11: Surely for those who believe and do the right are gardens with rivers running by. That is the greatest success.
verse.verse_12: The grip of your Lord is severe indeed!
verse.verse_13: It is verily He who initiates and repeats.
verse.verse_14: He is the forgiving and the loving,
verse.verse_15: The Lord of the glorious Throne,
verse.verse_17: Has the story of the hordes
verse.verse_18: Of Pharaoh and Thamud come to you?
verse.verse_19: Yet the infidels persist in denial.
verse.verse_20: But God surrounds them from all sides.
verse.verse_21: This is indeed the glorious Qur'an
